def design(feats) -> Design:
    X, y, ids = np.asarray(feats.x, float), np.asarray(feats.y, float), tuple(feats.ids)
    n, p = X.shape
    if p == 0 or n < 10 or np.unique(y).size < 2 or MAX_DRIVERS < 1:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    Z = X - X.mean(0); Z /= np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(Z, axis=0), 1e-12)
    R = Z.T @ Z; degree = (np.abs(R) >= .6).sum(0) - 1
    hubs = []
    for j in np.argsort(-degree, kind='stable'):
        if feats.types[j] == 'clinical' and degree[j] >= 3:
            if not any(abs(R[j, k]) >= .8 for k in hubs): hubs.append(int(j))
        if len(hubs) == 3: break
    labs = list(dict.fromkeys(feats.stratum)); labels = np.asarray(feats.stratum)
    S = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [labels == l for l in labs[1:]])
    cache = {}
    def fit(cols, products=()):
        key = (tuple(sorted(set(cols))), tuple(products))
        if key in cache: return cache[key]
        A = np.column_stack([S, X[:, key[0]]] + [X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in products])
        b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        for _ in range(35):
            t = A @ b; q = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(t, -30, 30))); w = np.maximum(q * (1 - q), 1e-8)
            H = A.T @ (w[:, None] * A) + 1e-6 * np.eye(len(b))
            d = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y - q)); d *= min(1., 5. / max(5., np.max(np.abs(d))))
            old = np.sum(y * t - np.logaddexp(0, t))
            for _ in range(12):
                t = A @ (b + d)
                if np.sum(y * t - np.logaddexp(0, t)) >= old - 1e-9: break
                d *= .5
            b += d
            if np.max(np.abs(d)) < 1e-7: break
        t = A @ b; q = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(t, -30, 30)))
        cache[key] = (float(np.sum(y * t - np.logaddexp(0, t))), A, q)
        return cache[key]
    def gain(cols, j, products=()):
        return max(0., 2 * (fit(cols + [j], products)[0] - fit(cols, products)[0]))
    sel = []
    for k in range(min(p, MAX_DRIVERS + len(hubs))):
        tests = []
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(s not in hubs and abs(R[j, s]) >= .95 for s in sel): continue
            adj = sorted((set(sel) | set(hubs)) - {j})
            tests.append((gain(adj, j), j))
        if not tests: break
        g, j = max(tests)
        if stats.chi2.sf(g, 1) > (.05 if k == 0 else .01) / p: break
        sel.append(j)
    for i, j in enumerate(sel):
        adj = sorted((set(sel) | set(hubs)) - {j})
        group = [c for c in range(p) if c not in adj and abs(R[j, c]) >= .6]
        fits = {c: fit(adj + [c])[0] for c in group}
        c = max(fits, key=fits.get)
        if fits[c] > fits[j] + 2: sel[i] = c; hubs = [h for h in hubs if h != j]
    for _ in range(len(sel)):
        gains = {j: gain(sorted((set(sel) | set(hubs)) - {j}), j) for j in sel}
        j = min(gains, key=gains.get)
        if stats.chi2.sf(gains[j], 1) <= .01 / p: break
        sel.remove(j)
    sel = sorted(sel, key=lambda j: -gain(sorted((set(sel) | set(hubs)) - {j}), j))[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    controls = sorted(set(sel) | set(hubs)); _, A, q = fit(controls)
    w = np.maximum(q * (1 - q), 1e-8); resid = y - q
    Hinv = np.linalg.pinv(A.T @ (w[:, None] * A)); candidates = []
    for a in range(p):
        bs = np.arange(a, p); V = X[:, a, None] * X[:, bs]; V -= V.mean(0)
        B = A.T @ (w[:, None] * V)
        variance = np.sum(w[:, None] * V * V, 0) - np.sum(B * (Hinv @ B), 0)
        score = (V.T @ resid) ** 2 / np.maximum(variance, 1e-10)
        candidates.extend((float(score[i]), a, int(bs[i])) for i in np.argsort(-score)[:3])
    products = []; threshold = .001 / (p * (p + 1) / 2)
    for _, a, b in sorted(candidates, reverse=True)[:20]:
        if a != b and abs(R[a, b]) >= .95: continue
        if len(set(sel) | {a, b}) > MAX_DRIVERS: continue
        mains = sorted(set(controls) | {a, b})
        g = max(0., 2 * (fit(mains, [(a, b)])[0] - fit(mains)[0]))
        if stats.chi2.sf(g, 1) < threshold:
            products = [(a, b)]; sel = list(dict.fromkeys(sel + [a, b])); break
    columns = sorted(set(sel) | set(hubs)) if sel else []
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in sel), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in columns),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in products), loadings={})
